text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, clindamycin in 5 percent dextrose 6 mg/mL 50 mL bags are critically low at Corvale East (6.2 days on hand, 88 bags) while Corvale Lakeside holds 19.2 days (78 bags). Corvale General has 11.6 days (181 bags). The shortage affects Baxter Healthcare, Pfizer Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, and Sandoz Inc. Our sites use Sandoz product NDC 0781-3288-09, labeled with InfoRLife SA as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the clindamycin phosphate injection shortage on 2023-03-21 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspection 1165537 at Bryant Ranch PrePack (FEI 1000519407) ended 2022-03-17, classified VAI, with classification letter dated 2022-05-19 — 369 days before FDA posted the shortage.

Our position: Corvale East needs immediate supply relief. Corvale Lakeside can spare inventory without dropping below two weeks. Alternative suppliers not on the FDA shortage list exist but require procurement lead time.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 21 bags of 6 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — raises Corvale East to 8 days on hand; Corvale Lakeside retains two weeks. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Initiate purchase from Civica, Inc. — not on FDA shortage list; plant InfoRLife SA. Approval: Buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — not on FDA shortage list; plant not identified on label. Approval: Buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC — not on FDA shortage list; plant not identified on label. Approval: Buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from ProPharma Distribution — not on FDA shortage list; plant not identified on label. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
